user.title: Aqara account
user.description: Sign in to Aqara, or enter a user ID and token you already hold to skip the login. Only the session token is stored; your password is not kept.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The Aqara cloud no longer accepts the stored token. Sign in again for region {region}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Aqara cloud.
error.missing_credentials: Enter either your email and password, or a user ID and token.

abort.already_configured: This Aqara account is already set up.

user.title: Add a device
user.description: Devices on your Aqara account that this integration can read cloud-only values for. One per run; rerun to add more.

abort.no_devices: No devices left to add. Either they are all added already, or this account has none whose cloud-only values are known to this integration.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Aqara cloud.
abort.invalid_auth: The stored token was rejected. Reconfigure the integration.
